units: <cite ref="Shabbat 128b:11">Sabb. 128ᵇ</cite> <he>דַּדּוּיֵי מְדַרִּינָן</he> pull them we may, opp. <cite ref="P01214"><he>עקר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 24a">B. Bath. 24</cite> as <cite ref="D00131">preced.</cite> Hithpa.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 24a">B. Bath. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דמִידַּדֵּי וכ׳</he> any young bird which hops, will hop only within sight of its nest.
<cite ref="Beitzah 11a:6">Bets. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>אִידַּדּוּיֵי אִידַּדּוּ</he> they came hopping (from the nest).
<cite ref="Shabbat 99b">Sabb. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא לִדַּדּוּ וכ׳</he> that the boards should not shake.

senses.gloss: to move about. Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ top כיני אורחא דזבונה מִדַּדְיָיה it is the habit of traders to travel from place to place.
